ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-contrast ratio; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three-dimensional barnacle organisms along the superior edge of the left lobe tip, protruding beyond the standard pigment boundary.
